title.zh: 卷264 列傳五十一 郝维讷 任克溥 刘鸿儒 刘楗 张廷枢
title.en: Volume 264 Biographies 51: Hao Weine, Ren Kepu, Liu Hongru, Liu Jian, Zhang Tingshu
title.raw: 卷264 列傳五十一 郝维讷 任克溥 刘鸿儒 刘楗 张廷枢

sentences.zh: 郝維訥，字敏公，直隸霸州人。

translations.literal: Hao Weine, courtesy name Mingong, was a native of Bazhou in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Weine, styled Mingong, was from Bazhou in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 父傑，明崇禎進士。

translations.literal: His father Jie was a jinshi of the Ming in the Chongzhen reign.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jie had passed the metropolitan examination in the Chongzhen reign of the Ming.

sentences.zh: 順治初，授行人，遷戶部給事中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Shunzhi reign, he was appointed Bearer of the Imperial Seal and transferred to Supervising Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shunzhi era he was appointed a Bearer of the Imperial Seal, then promoted to Supervising Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 迭疏請開經筵，祀闕里，廢斥諸臣才堪錄用者量予自新，朝賀大典內監不得入班行禮，俱下部議行。

translations.literal: He submitted repeated memorials requesting the opening of the imperial lecture on the classics, sacrifices at Qufu, that dismissed officials whose talents could still be employed be given opportunity for self-renewal according to circumstances, and that eunuchs not enter the ranks to perform rites at grand court ceremonies; all were referred to the ministries for deliberation and execution.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted repeated memorials calling for the imperial lecture on the classics, sacrifices at Confucius's birthplace in Qufu, opportunities for dismissed officials whose talents merited reuse to reform themselves, and a ban on eunuchs joining the formal ranks at grand court ceremonies; all were referred to the relevant ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 累遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 維訥，順治四年進士，授刑部主事，再遷郎中。

translations.literal: Weine, a jinshi of the fourth year of Shunzhi, was appointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Justice and was promoted twice to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: Weine passed the metropolitan examination in the fourth year of Shunzhi, was appointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Justice, and was promoted twice to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 七年，出為福建督糧道僉事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was sent out as Assistant Commissioner of the Fujian grain transport circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was posted as Assistant Commissioner of the Fujian grain transport circuit.

sentences.zh: 師下漳南，糧運多阻，維訥督米二萬石浮海達泉州以濟軍。

translations.literal: When the army advanced south of Zhangzhou, grain transport was often obstructed; Weine supervised twenty thousand shi of rice transported by sea to Quanzhou to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: When imperial troops moved into southern Zhangzhou, grain shipments ran into many obstacles; Weine personally oversaw twenty thousand shi of rice sent by sea to Quanzhou to sustain the army.

sentences.zh: 巨盜張自盛犯延、卲，徙維訥權延建卲道，設方略，用間散其黨，自盛就擒。

translations.literal: The great bandit Zhang Zisheng raided Yan and Shao; Weine was transferred to serve as acting commissioner of the Yan-Jian-Shao circuit, devised strategy, used agents to scatter his band, and Zisheng was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The notorious bandit Zhang Zisheng raided the Yan and Shao region; Weine was reassigned as acting commissioner of the Yan-Jian-Shao circuit, laid plans, sent infiltrators to break up his gang, and Zhang was captured.

sentences.zh: 尋署按察使，謝苞苴，絕羨耗。

translations.literal: Soon he served as acting provincial judicial commissioner, refused bribes, and eliminated illegal surcharges.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as acting provincial judicial commissioner, refused gifts of influence, and put a stop to illegal exactions.

sentences.zh: 舉卓異，復用孫承澤、成克鞏薦，十一年，召授通政司右參議。

translations.literal: Rated outstanding, he was again recommended by Sun Chengzhe and Cheng Kegong; in the eleventh year he was summoned and appointed Right Assistant Director in the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: Rated outstanding in his evaluations and recommended again by Sun Chengzhe and Cheng Kegong, in the eleventh year he was summoned to serve as Right Assistant Director in the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 累遷大理寺卿。

translations.literal: He was promoted successively to President of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to President of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢戶部侍郎，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十六年，丁父憂。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he entered mourning for his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he entered mourning upon his father's death.

sentences.zh: 服闋，起戶部侍郎，復調吏部。

translations.literal: When his mourning ended, he was recalled as Vice Minister of Revenue and again transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning period ended, he was recalled as Vice Minister of Revenue and again transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，典會試，尋擢左都御史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he presided over the metropolitan examination and was soon promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kangxi he presided over the metropolitan examination and was soon promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 維訥以開國二十餘年，南徼初定，民困未蘇，疏言：「天下大弊在民窮財盡，連年川、湖、閩、廣、雲、貴無不增兵增餉，本省不支，他省協濟。

translations.literal: Weine, considering that more than twenty years had passed since the founding of the dynasty and the southern frontiers were newly pacified but the people's hardships had not yet eased, memorialized: "The great ill of the realm lies in the exhaustion of the people and the depletion of finances. Year after year Sichuan, Huguang, Fujian, Guangdong, Yunnan, and Guizhou have all increased troops and supplies; the home province cannot sustain them and other provinces must contribute aid."
translations.idiomatic: Weine, reflecting that more than twenty years had passed since the founding of the dynasty and that although the southern frontiers were newly pacified the people had not yet recovered, memorialized: "The gravest problem facing the realm is the exhaustion of the people and the depletion of state finances. Year after year Sichuan, Huguang, Fujian, Guangdong, Yunnan, and Guizhou have all added troops and increased supplies; the home province cannot bear the cost and other provinces must send aid."

sentences.zh: 臣觀川、湖等省尚多曠土，若選綠旗及降兵精銳者隸之營伍，給以牛種，所在屯田，則供應減而協濟可以永除，閭里無追呼之困。

translations.literal: Your servant observes that Sichuan, Huguang, and other provinces still have much wasteland. If selected Green Banner troops and surrendered soldiers of quality were enrolled in garrisons, given oxen and seed, and garrison farming established everywhere, then supplies could be reduced and mutual aid contributions permanently eliminated, and villages would be free from the distress of forced levies.
translations.idiomatic: I observe that Sichuan, Huguang, and other provinces still have much uncultivated land. If selected Green Banner troops and capable surrendered soldiers were enrolled in garrison units, given oxen and seed, and assigned to farm wherever they were stationed, supplies would diminish, mutual aid contributions could be abolished for good, and villages would no longer suffer the torment of forced requisitions.

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「巡按既裁，地方巡視責歸督撫。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Since touring censors have been abolished, responsibility for local inspection falls to governors-general and governors."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Now that touring censors have been abolished, responsibility for inspecting the provinces falls to governors-general and governors."

sentences.zh: 督撫任重事繁，出巡動逾旬月，恐誤公務，況騎從眾多，經過滋擾。

translations.literal: Governors bear heavy responsibility and numerous duties; tours often exceed ten days and a month, likely delaying official business, and moreover their large entourages cause disturbances wherever they pass.
translations.idiomatic: Governors carry heavy responsibilities and a crowded agenda; an inspection tour often lasts more than ten days or a month, which may delay official business, and their large retinues disturb the places they pass through.

sentences.zh: 至屬官貪廉，閭閻疾苦，諮訪耳目，仍寄司道。

translations.literal: As for the integrity of subordinate officials and the hardships of the people, inquiry and intelligence still depend on provincial and circuit commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: As for whether subordinate officials are corrupt or honest and what hardships the people endure, the channels for inquiry still rest with the provincial and circuit commissioners.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後事關重大者，仍親身巡察，餘概停止。

translations.literal: I request that henceforth only matters of major importance require personal inspection; the rest should cease altogether.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that henceforth only matters of major importance require personal inspection, and that all other tours be discontinued.

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「山西、山東等省偏旱，發帑賑濟，聖恩至為優渥，特窮鄉僻壤恐難遍及，惟蠲免錢糧，率土均霑實惠。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Shanxi, Shandong, and other provinces have suffered partial drought. The disbursement of treasury funds for relief reflects the Emperor's most generous grace, yet remote hamlets may be hard to reach; only remission of land tax and grain levies can spread the real benefit evenly across the realm."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Shanxi, Shandong, and other provinces have suffered partial drought. The disbursement of treasury funds for relief shows the Emperor's extraordinary grace, yet remote villages may be hard to reach; only remission of land tax and grain levies can spread the real benefit evenly across the realm."

sentences.zh: 但田有田賦，丁有丁差，前者被災地方，例多免糧不免丁；

translations.literal: But land has land tax and households have corvée obligations; in disaster-affected areas, precedent usually remits grain tax but not corvée.
translations.idiomatic: But land carries land tax and households carry corvée obligations; in disaster-stricken areas, precedent usually remits grain tax but not corvée dues.

sentences.zh: 其有丁無田者，反不得與有田之戶同霑恩澤。

translations.literal: Those who owe corvée but hold no land cannot share the same grace as landholding households.
translations.idiomatic: Those liable for corvée but without land cannot share the same benefit as landholding households.

sentences.zh: 請丁銀均如田糧分數蠲免。

translations.literal: I request that corvée silver be remitted in the same proportions as grain tax.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that corvée silver be remitted in the same proportions as grain tax.

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「貪吏罪至死者，遇赦免死，並免交吏部議處。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Corrupt officials sentenced to death receive commuted punishment at amnesties and are also exempted from referral to the Ministry of Personnel for disposition."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Corrupt officials sentenced to death have their punishment commuted at amnesties and are also exempted from referral to the Ministry of Personnel for disposition."

sentences.zh: 此曹饕餮狼藉，未可令其復玷名器，貽害地方。

translations.literal: These greedy, disorderly men must not be allowed to again stain official insignia and bring harm to the regions.
translations.idiomatic: These rapacious and disorderly men must not be allowed to stain official insignia again and bring harm to the regions they serve.

sentences.zh: 雖新例赴部另補，貪殘所至，播虐惟均。

translations.literal: Though under new regulations they report to the ministry for reassignment, wherever the greedy and cruel go, they spread suffering equally.
translations.idiomatic: Although under new regulations they report to the ministry for reassignment, wherever the greedy and cruel go they spread suffering just the same.

sentences.zh: 請敕部定議，凡贓款審實者，遇赦免罪，仍當奪官。

translations.literal: I request an imperial order to the ministry to establish that all those whose embezzlement is verified shall, even if pardoned from punishment at amnesty, still lose their office.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the ministry be ordered to rule that all whose embezzlement is verified shall, even if pardoned from punishment at amnesty, still be stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 庶官箴可肅，民害可除。

translations.literal: Thus official discipline may be upheld and harm to the people removed.
translations.idiomatic: In this way official discipline may be upheld and harm to the people removed.

sentences.zh: 」皆下部議行。

translations.literal: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and execution.
translations.idiomatic: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷工部尚書，調刑、禮二部。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Minister of Works and then to the Ministries of Justice and Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Minister of Works and then to the Ministries of Justice and Rites.

sentences.zh: 八年，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 疏請停督撫勘災，申禁圈取民地，並得旨允行。

translations.literal: He memorialized to stop governors from personally inspecting disasters and petitioned to prohibit seizure of civilian land for banner estates; both were approved by imperial decree.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to stop governors from personally inspecting disaster areas and petitioned to prohibit the seizure of civilian land for banner estates; both received imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 時兵興開捐納，正途日壅，維訥為斟酌資格，按缺分選，銓法稱平。

translations.literal: At the time war had opened purchase offices; regular promotion routes were clogged daily; Weine weighed qualifications and assigned selections by vacancy; the nomination system was praised as fair.
translations.idiomatic: At the time war had opened offices for purchase of rank, and the regular route to office grew more congested by the day; Weine weighed qualifications carefully and assigned selections by vacancy, and the nomination system was praised as equitable.

sentences.zh: 十八年，給事中姚締虞請寬免科道風聞言事之禁，下廷臣議，維訥謂：「言官奏事，原不禁其風聞。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Supervising Secretary Yao Dyu requested relaxation of restrictions on censorial reporting based on rumor; the matter was referred to court officials for discussion; Weine said: "Memorializing censors were never forbidden from reporting what they hear."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Supervising Secretary Yao Dyu asked that restrictions on censorial reporting based on rumor be relaxed; the matter was referred to court officials for discussion; Weine said: "Memorializing censors were never forbidden from reporting what they hear."

sentences.zh: 但風聞奏參審問全虛者，例有處分，否則慮有藉風聞挾私報怨者，請仍照定例行。

translations.literal: But when impeachment based on rumor proves entirely false upon investigation, there are prescribed penalties; otherwise there is concern that some use rumor to settle private scores. I request that established regulations continue to be followed.
translations.idiomatic: But when impeachment based on rumor proves entirely false upon investigation, there are prescribed penalties; otherwise there is concern that some will use rumor to settle private scores. I ask that established regulations continue to be followed.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 維訥領吏、戶二部最久，法制多經裁定。

translations.literal: Weine headed the Ministries of Personnel and Revenue longest; many regulations were adjudicated through him.
translations.idiomatic: Weine headed the Ministries of Personnel and Revenue longer than any other office, and many regulations were settled through his judgment.

sentences.zh: 凡事持大體，遇會議、會推、朝審，委曲斟酌，期於至當。

translations.literal: In all matters he held to the broader principles; at joint conferences, collective nominations, and annual capital trials he weighed matters carefully, aiming at what was most fitting.
translations.idiomatic: In all matters he held to the larger principles; at joint conferences, collective nominations, and annual capital trials he weighed every detail carefully, aiming at what was most fitting.

sentences.zh: 敷奏條暢，所見與眾偶有同異，開陳端緒，不留隱情，上深重之，往往從其言。

translations.literal: His memorials were clear and fluent; when his views occasionally differed from others', he laid out the reasoning without concealing anything; the Emperor deeply valued him and often followed his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: His memorials were clear and fluent; when his views occasionally differed from others', he laid out the reasoning without concealing anything; the Emperor held him in deep regard and often followed his counsel.

sentences.zh: 十九年，遭母憂。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he entered mourning for his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he entered mourning upon his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 服闋，詣京師，未補官，卒，諡恭定。

translations.literal: When his mourning ended, he went to the capital; before receiving appointment he died; his posthumous title was Gongding.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning period ended he went to the capital, but before he could be reappointed he died; he was given the posthumous title Gongding.

sentences.zh: 任克溥，字海眉，山東聊城人。

translations.literal: Ren Kepu, courtesy name Haimei, was a native of Liaocheng in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Kepu, styled Haimei, was from Liaocheng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 順治四年進士，授南陽府推官。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the fourth year of Shunzhi, he was appointed reviewing officer of Nanyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the metropolitan examination in the fourth year of Shunzhi, he was appointed reviewing officer of Nanyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 卓異行取，十三年，授吏科給事中。

translations.literal: Rated outstanding and selected by special channel, in the thirteenth year he was appointed Supervising Secretary in the Personnel Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Rated outstanding and selected by special channel, in the thirteenth year he was appointed Supervising Secretary in the Personnel Bureau.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「上勵精圖治，知親民之官莫過守令，特擇各府繁劇難治者，許三品以上各舉一人，破格任用。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Your Majesty is striving to govern well and knows that among officials who serve the people none surpass prefects and magistrates; you have specially chosen the busiest and most difficult prefectures and allowed officials of the third rank and above each to recommend one person for extraordinary appointment."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Your Majesty is striving to govern well and knows that among officials who serve the people none surpass prefects and magistrates; you have specially chosen the busiest and most difficult prefectures and allowed officials of the third rank and above each to recommend one person for extraordinary appointment."

sentences.zh: 使保舉得當，一人賢則一郡安，人人賢則各省安，太平何難立致。

translations.literal: If recommendations are made properly, one worthy man brings peace to one prefecture, and if every man is worthy then every province is at peace; how difficult would it be to achieve great tranquility?
translations.idiomatic: If recommendations are made properly, one worthy man brings peace to one prefecture, and if every man is worthy then every province is at peace; how difficult would it be to achieve lasting peace?

sentences.zh: 乃為時未久，以貪庸劾罷者已有數人，前此保舉不能秉公慎選可知。

translations.literal: Yet not much time has passed and several men have already been impeached and dismissed for greed and incompetence; it is clear that the earlier recommendations were not made with impartial and careful selection.
translations.idiomatic: Yet not much time has passed and several men have already been impeached and dismissed for greed and incompetence; it is clear that the earlier recommendations were not made with impartial and careful selection.

sentences.zh: 乞敕部察處。

translations.literal: I beg that the ministry be ordered to investigate and take action.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the ministry be ordered to investigate and take action.

sentences.zh: 十四年，轉刑科，疏言：「抗糧弊有三：宦戶、儒戶、衙蠹。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he transferred to the Punishments Bureau and memorialized: "There are three abuses in resisting grain payments: official households, scholar households, and yamen parasites."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he transferred to the Punishments Bureau and memorialized: "There are three abuses in resisting grain payments: official households, scholar households, and yamen parasites."

sentences.zh: 宜分三項，各另造冊，申報總督、巡撫、巡按，宦欠者題參，衿欠者褫革，役欠者逮治。

translations.literal: They should be divided into three categories with separate registers reported to governors-general, governors, and touring censors; official arrears should be reported for impeachment, gentry arrears stripped of status, and clerk arrears arrested and punished.
translations.idiomatic: They should be divided into three categories with separate registers reported to governors-general, governors, and touring censors; official arrears should be reported for impeachment, gentry arrears should lead to stripping of status, and clerk arrears should lead to arrest and punishment.

sentences.zh: 」复疏論順天鄉試給事中陸貽吉與同考官李振鄴、張我樸交通行賄鬻舉人，下吏部、都察院嚴鞫，貽吉、振鄴、我樸與居間博士蔡元禧，進士項紹芳，行賄舉人田耜、鄔作霖皆坐斬。

translations.literal: He also memorialized on Supervising Secretary Lu Yiji of the Shuntian provincial examination and fellow examiners Li Zhenye and Zhang Wopu for collusion, bribery, and selling degrees; the case was referred to the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate for strict interrogation; Yiji, Zhenye, Wopu, the intermediary licentiate Cai Yuanxi, jinshi Xiang Shaofang, and the bribing candidates Tian Si and Wu Zuolin were all sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized against Supervising Secretary Lu Yiji of the Shuntian provincial examination and fellow examiners Li Zhenye and Zhang Wopu for collusion, bribery, and selling degrees; the case was referred to the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate for strict interrogation; Yiji, Zhenye, Wopu, the intermediary licentiate Cai Yuanxi, jinshi Xiang Shaofang, and the bribing candidates Tian Si and Wu Zuolin were all sentenced to decapitation.

sentences.zh: 命禮部覆試不及程者，褫奪流徙又二十五人，考官庶子曹本榮、中允宋之繩並坐降調。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites was ordered to re-examine those who fell short of standards; twenty-five more were stripped of degrees and exiled; examiners Reader-in-waiting Cao Benrong and Assistant Reader Song Zhisheng were also demoted.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites was ordered to re-examine those who fell short of standards; twenty-five more were stripped of degrees and exiled; examiners Reader-in-waiting Cao Benrong and Assistant Reader Song Zhisheng were also demoted.

sentences.zh: 十五年，充會試同考官，出闈，疏言：「伏讀上諭，令各衙門條奏興利除弊。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he served as associate examiner for the metropolitan examination; after leaving the examination hall he memorialized: "I have read Your Majesty's edict ordering each office to submit detailed memorials on promoting benefit and removing abuse."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he served as associate examiner for the metropolitan examination; after leaving the examination hall he memorialized: "I have read Your Majesty's edict ordering each office to submit detailed memorials on promoting benefit and removing abuse."

sentences.zh: 時近兩月，僅見宗人府一疏，各衙門遲疑觀望。

translations.literal: Nearly two months have passed and only one memorial from the Imperial Clan Court has appeared; the various offices hesitate and wait to see.
translations.idiomatic: Nearly two months have passed and only one memorial from the Imperial Clan Court has appeared; the various offices hesitate and wait to see.

sentences.zh: 竊謂其病有二：一則因循既久，發論方新，恐無以贖往日曠官之咎；

translations.literal: I venture to say there are two ailments: first, after long inertia a new policy has just been announced, and they fear they cannot atone for past neglect of duty.
translations.idiomatic: I venture to say there are two ailments: first, after long inertia a new policy has just been announced, and they fear they cannot atone for past neglect of duty.

sentences.zh: 一則瞻望多端，指陳無隱，恐無以留後來遷就之門。

translations.literal: Second, they look in many directions; if they speak frankly without concealment, they fear they will leave no room for later compromise.
translations.idiomatic: Second, they look in many directions; if they speak frankly without concealment, they fear they will leave no room for later compromise.

sentences.zh: 臣子報國，止有朴忠，遇事直陳；

translations.literal: In serving the state, ministers have only plain loyalty and should speak directly when matters arise.
translations.idiomatic: In serving the state, ministers have only plain loyalty and should speak directly when matters arise.

sentences.zh: 稍一轉念，便持兩端，勢必摭拾瑣屑，剿說雷同，不能慷慨論列，又安望設誠致行？

translations.literal: With the slightest second thought they become equivocal, inevitably picking up trivialities and repeating commonplaces, unable to speak boldly and at length; how then can one expect sincere counsel put into action?
translations.idiomatic: With the slightest second thought they become equivocal, inevitably picking up trivialities and repeating commonplaces, unable to speak boldly and at length; how then can one expect sincere counsel put into action?

sentences.zh: 乞嚴飭不得浮泛塞責，並鑑別當否，示以勸懲。

translations.idiomatic: I ask that strict orders be issued forbidding perfunctory evasion of responsibility, and that right and wrong be distinguished to show reward and punishment.

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「近以各衙門胥役作姦犯科，詔令諸臣計議指摘。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Recently, because clerks and runners in the various offices have committed crimes, an edict ordered officials to deliberate and expose abuses."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Recently, because clerks and runners in the various offices have committed crimes, an edict ordered officials to deliberate and expose abuses."

sentences.zh: 臣以為懲於弊後，不若杜於弊先，如吏部文選司推升原有定序，應先懸榜部門，序列姓名、資俸、薦紀、參罰，使共見共聞；

translations.literal: Your servant believes that punishing abuse after the fact is inferior to stopping it beforehand. For example, the Ministry of Personnel's Bureau of Appointments has a fixed order for promotions; lists should first be posted at the ministry gate, setting out names, seniority, recommendations, and penalties so all may see and hear together.
translations.idiomatic: I believe that punishing abuse after the fact is inferior to stopping it beforehand. sentences.zh: 考功司議處條例，亦畫一頒發，使不得輕重增減。

translations.literal: The regulations for disposition in the Bureau of Evaluation should also be issued uniformly so that penalties cannot be increased or reduced arbitrarily.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations for disposition in the Bureau of Evaluation should also be issued uniformly so that penalties cannot be increased or reduced arbitrarily.

sentences.zh: 至各官開缺，以科鈔為憑，向以發鈔後先轉移舞弊。

translations.literal: As for vacancies in offices, appointment depends on the bureau copy; in the past manipulation occurred by shifting the order after copies were issued.
translations.idiomatic: As for vacancies in offices, appointment depends on the bureau copy; in the past manipulation occurred by shifting the order after copies were issued.

sentences.zh: 如當逮問，先下刑部，與事止奪官、迳下吏部者遲速有異。

translations.literal: When arrest and interrogation are required, referral first goes to the Ministry of Justice, which differs in speed from cases in which only dismissal is involved and referral goes directly to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When arrest and interrogation are required, referral first goes to the Ministry of Justice, which differs in speed from cases in which only dismissal is involved and referral goes directly to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 應令即日鈔發，使不容操縱。

translations.literal: Copies should be issued the same day so that manipulation is not possible.
translations.idiomatic: Copies should be issued the same day so that manipulation is not possible.

sentences.zh: 」上以所奏切中時弊，下部詳議行。

translations.literal: The Emperor considered his memorial to hit the abuses of the time squarely and referred it to the ministries for detailed deliberation and execution.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor considered his memorial to hit the abuses of the time squarely and referred it to the ministries for detailed deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 轉禮科都給事中，疏言：「士為四民首，宜端習尚。

translations.literal: He transferred to Chief Supervising Secretary of the Rites Bureau and memorialized: "Scholars stand at the head of the four classes of people and should uphold proper conduct."
translations.idiomatic: He transferred to Chief Supervising Secretary of the Rites Bureau and memorialized: "Scholars stand at the head of the four classes of people and should uphold proper conduct."

sentences.zh: 請敕學臣，凡有請託私書，許揭送部科，差滿定為上考。

translations.literal: I request that education officials be ordered that whenever private letters seeking favor arrive, they may be reported to the ministry and bureau, and at the end of term this shall count as a top evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that education officials be ordered that whenever private letters seeking favor arrive, they may be reported to the ministry and bureau, and at the end of term this shall count as a top evaluation.

sentences.zh: 並令舉優當訪學行著聞之士，懲劣則以抗糧為最重。

translations.literal: They should also be ordered that in recommending the outstanding they seek men of renowned learning and conduct, and in punishing the inferior the gravest offense is resisting grain payments.
translations.idiomatic: They should also be ordered that in recommending the outstanding they seek men of renowned learning and conduct, and in punishing the inferior the gravest offense is resisting grain payments.

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「錢糧逋欠，非盡在民。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Arrears in tax and grain payments are not entirely the fault of the people."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Arrears in tax and grain payments are not entirely the fault of the people."

sentences.zh: 臣前奏三款，部議分冊申報，得旨允行；

translations.literal: Your servant previously memorialized on the three categories; the ministry deliberated on separate registers for reporting and received imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: I previously memorialized on the three categories; the ministry deliberated on separate registers for reporting and received imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 而造冊奏報者，惟山西一省耳。

translations.literal: Yet only Shanxi Province has compiled registers and reported them.
translations.idiomatic: Yet only Shanxi Province has compiled registers and reported them.

sentences.zh: 諸省玩洩從事，不肯實心清理，徒以開荒增課，一時博優敘之榮，仍聽其逋欠而不之問，請飭部察覈；

translations.literal: The provinces treat the matter lightly and slackly, unwilling to clean up in earnest, merely seeking temporary glory through reclamation and increased assessments while still allowing arrears to go unchecked; I request that the ministry be ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The provinces treat the matter lightly and slackly, unwilling to clean up in earnest, merely seeking temporary glory through reclamation and increased assessments while still allowing arrears to go unchecked; I ask that the ministry be ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 又紳衿抗糧，定有新條，蠹役尤應加嚴，並請敕部定例行。

translations.literal: There are also new regulations on gentry resisting grain payments, and yamen parasites should be treated with especial severity; I also request that the ministry be ordered to establish regulations and follow them.
translations.idiomatic: There are also new regulations on gentry resisting grain payments, and yamen parasites should be treated with especial severity; I also ask that the ministry be ordered to establish regulations and follow them.

sentences.zh: 」十七年，遷太常寺少卿。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 十八年，遭父喪。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he entered mourning for his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he entered mourning upon his father's death.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，起補原官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he was recalled to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kangxi he was recalled to his former office.

sentences.zh: 六年，疏言：「朝廷欲薄賦，有司反加賦；

translations.literal: In the sixth year he memorialized: "The court wishes to lighten taxes, yet local officials instead increase them."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he memorialized: "The court wishes to lighten taxes, yet local officials instead increase them."

sentences.zh: 朝廷欲省刑，有司反濫刑：皆由督撫不得其人。

translations.literal: The court wishes to reduce punishments, yet local officials instead abuse punishments: all because governors-general and governors are not the right men.
translations.idiomatic: The court wishes to reduce punishments, yet local officials instead abuse punishments: all because governors-general and governors are not the right men.

sentences.zh: 今方有詔令部院糾察，部院肯糾極貪大惡之督撫一人，天下為督撫者警；

translations.literal: An edict has just been issued ordering ministries and courts to investigate; if the ministries and courts will impeach one governor-general or governor of extreme greed and great wickedness, all who serve as governors-general and governors will be warned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict has just been issued ordering ministries and courts to investigate; if the ministries and courts will impeach one governor-general or governor of extreme greed and great wickedness, all who serve as governors-general and governors will be warned.

sentences.zh: 督撫肯糾極貪大惡之司道一人，天下為司道者警。

translations.literal: If governors-general and governors will impeach one provincial or circuit commissioner of extreme greed and great wickedness, all who serve as provincial and circuit commissioners will be warned.
translations.idiomatic: If governors-general and governors will impeach one provincial or circuit commissioner of extreme greed and great wickedness, all who serve as provincial and circuit commissioners will be warned.

sentences.zh: 督撫、司道廉潔，則有司不苦誅求，輕徭薄賦，政簡刑清，自寬然有餘地矣。

translations.literal: If governors-general, governors, and provincial and circuit commissioners are honest and clean, then local officials will not suffer from exactions; with light corvée and low taxes, simplified government and clear punishments, there will naturally be room to spare.
translations.idiomatic: If governors-general, governors, and provincial and circuit commissioners are honest and clean, then local officials will not suffer from exactions; with light corvée and low taxes, simplified government and clear punishments, there will naturally be room to spare.

sentences.zh: 」八年，應詔陳民生疾苦，言：「小民莫疾於加派，莫苦於火耗，已敕嚴禁矣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, responding to an edict to report the people's hardships, he said: "Among common people nothing is more grievous than additional levies, and nothing more painful than meltage fees; these have already been strictly forbidden by edict."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, responding to an edict to report the people's hardships, he said: "Among common people nothing is more grievous than additional levies, and nothing more painful than meltage fees; these have already been strictly forbidden by edict."

sentences.zh: 此外疾苦尚有數端：有司派殷戶催糧，糧單中多列逃亡絕戶，無可徵糧；

translations.literal: Beyond this there are still several hardships: local officials assign wealthy households to press for grain, and grain lists often list fugitive and extinct households for which no grain can be collected.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond this there are still several hardships: local officials assign wealthy households to press for grain, and grain lists often list fugitive and extinct households for which no grain can be collected.

sentences.zh: 且有糧冊無名，按時追比，致傾家以償者。

translations.literal: Moreover there are names absent from grain registers who are pursued on schedule, causing families to be ruined in payment.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover there are people absent from grain registers who are pursued on schedule, causing families to be ruined in payment.

sentences.zh: 郵傳供應，原有錢糧，或侵入私囊，僉民養馬應夫或充里長。

translations.literal: Postal relay supplies originally had designated funds, yet some are diverted to private pockets, and the people are conscripted to keep horses, serve as couriers, or act as village heads.
translations.idiomatic: Postal relay supplies originally had designated funds, yet some are diverted to private pockets, and the people are conscripted to keep horses, serve as couriers, or act as village heads.

sentences.zh: 使客往來，舟車飲食，責令設備。

translations.literal: When envoys come and go, boats, carts, food, and drink are all demanded to be provided.
translations.idiomatic: When envoys come and go, boats, carts, food, and drink are all demanded to be provided.

sentences.zh: 河漕附近，籍民應役，衣敝履決，力盡筋疲，而工食或至中飽。

translations.literal: Near the canal grain transport routes, registered civilians are conscripted for labor; in ragged clothes and worn shoes, their strength exhausted and sinews weary, yet wages and rations are sometimes embezzled.
translations.idiomatic: Near the canal grain transport routes, registered civilians are conscripted for labor; in ragged clothes and worn shoes, their strength exhausted and sinews weary, yet wages and rations are sometimes embezzled.

sentences.zh: 淺夫閘夫，賣富差貧，一名更至數十名，衙役捕系恫哧，民被累無窮。

translations.literal: Shallow-water laborers and lock keepers are assigned by selling off the rich and assigning the poor; one name may expand to dozens; yamen runners arrest and intimidate, and the people suffer endless harm.
translations.idiomatic: Shallow-water laborers and lock keepers are assigned by selling off the rich and assigning the poor; one name may expand to dozens; yamen runners arrest and intimidate, and the people suffer endless harm.

sentences.zh: 請敕督撫清釐懲禁。

translations.literal: I request that governors-general and governors be ordered to investigate, rectify, and forbid these abuses.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that governors-general and governors be ordered to investigate, rectify, and forbid these abuses.

translations.idiomatic: The Emperor accepted his counsel and specially ordered that canal works must not burden the people.

sentences.zh: 尋遷右、左通政。

translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Right and then Left Commissioner in the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 十一年，疏言：「嘉魚知縣李世錫告湖廣巡撫林天擎索賄，以此知餽遺不絕，苞苴尚行，較世祖朝有司不敢餽遺督撫、不敢輕至省會風氣迥殊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he memorialized: "Jiayu Magistrate Li Shixi reported that Huguang Governor Lin Tianqing solicited bribes; from this one knows that gifts never cease and bribes still circulate, a climate utterly different from the Shizu reign when local officials dared not give gifts to governors and dared not lightly visit provincial capitals."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he memorialized: "Jiayu Magistrate Li Shixi reported that Huguang Governor Lin Tianqing solicited bribes; from this one knows that gifts never cease and bribes still circulate, a climate utterly different from the Shizu reign when local officials dared not give gifts to governors and dared not lightly visit provincial capitals."

sentences.zh: 督撫初受命，群餽裘馬、弓矢，而為督撫者亦飾觀瞻、趨奢侈，一時費累萬。

translations.literal: When governors first receive appointment, crowds present furs, horses, bows, and arrows, and those who become governors also adorn their appearance and pursue luxury, spending tens of thousands at a time.
translations.idiomatic: When governors first receive appointment, crowds present furs, horses, bows, and arrows, and those who become governors also adorn their appearance and pursue luxury, spending tens of thousands at a time.

translations.literal: After taking office, to repay gifts they seek compensation, and thus harshly extort subordinate officials, bringing harm to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Once in office, to repay the gifts they had received, governors seek compensation and harshly squeeze their subordinates, passing the burden on to the people.

translations.literal: I request that governors-general and governors be ordered, before taking office, to reject all gifts, not display ostentatious travel arrangements, and cultivate integrity through frugality.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that governors-general and governors be ordered, before taking office, to reject all gifts, avoid ostentatious travel arrangements, and cultivate integrity through frugality.

sentences.zh: 督撫參罰科條甚密，部院亦當知督撫艱難繁重，依例處分，毋過為吹索，俾得專心吏治民生，無旁顧之憂。

translations.literal: The regulations for impeachment and punishment of governors are very strict; the ministries and courts should also know that governors' duties are arduous and heavy; they should dispose of cases according to precedent and not over-scrutinize, so that governors may devote themselves to administration and the people's livelihood without distraction.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations for impeaching and punishing governors are very strict; the ministries and courts should also recognize how arduous governors' duties are, dispose of cases according to precedent, and not over-scrutinize them, so that governors may devote themselves to administration and the people's livelihood without distraction.

sentences.zh: 」先後諸疏並下部議行。

translations.literal: All his successive memorials were referred to the ministries for deliberation and execution.
translations.idiomatic: All his successive memorials were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 十八年，京察，以才力不及擬降調，命再議，改註不謹，遂奪官。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, at the capital evaluation, he was proposed for demotion and transfer for insufficient talent and capacity; ordered for further deliberation, the notation was changed to lack of prudence, and he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, at the capital evaluation, he was proposed for demotion and transfer on grounds of insufficient talent and capacity; after further deliberation the notation was changed to lack of prudence, and he was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，迎蹕臨清，復原銜。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, when the Emperor's procession passed through Linqing, his original rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, when the Emperor's procession passed through Linqing, his original rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，南巡還蹕東昌，幸其所居園，賜松桂堂榜。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, returning from the southern tour and passing through Dongchang, the Emperor visited his garden residence and bestowed the plaque Songguitang.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, on the return from the southern tour and passing through Dongchang, the Emperor visited his garden residence and bestowed the plaque Songguitang.

sentences.zh: 以克溥年將九十，賜刑部尚書銜。

translations.literal: Because Kepu was nearing ninety years of age, he was granted the nominal rank of Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Because Kepu was nearing ninety, he was granted the nominal rank of Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 是歲卒，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: That year he died and was granted funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: That year he died and was granted state funeral rites.

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year of Qianlong, the Gaozong Emperor reviewed Kepu's detailed memorials, praised them, and decreed: "Kepu served two reigns, offered sincere counsel, and is worthy to be called a forthright and outspoken minister."
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year of Qianlong, the Gaozong Emperor reviewed Kepu's detailed memorials, praised them, and decreed: "Kepu served two reigns, offered sincere counsel, and is worthy to be called a forthright and outspoken minister."

sentences.zh: 」並命錄諸疏宣示。

translations.literal: He also ordered the memorials copied and promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered the memorials copied and promulgated.

sentences.zh: 劉鴻儒，字魯一，直隸遷安人。

translations.literal: Liu Hongru, courtesy name Luyi, was a native of Qian'an in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hongru, styled Luyi, was from Qian'an in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 順治三年進士，授兵科給事中。

translations.idiomatic: Having passed the metropolitan examination in the third year of Shunzhi, he was appointed Supervising Secretary in the Military Bureau.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「開國之始，首重安民，宜輕賦徭，革積弊。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "At the founding of the dynasty, settling the people comes first; taxes and corvée should be lightened and accumulated abuses reformed."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "At the founding of the dynasty, settling the people comes first; taxes and corvée should be lightened and accumulated abuses reformed."

sentences.zh: 伏讀恩詔，賦制悉依萬曆初年，及觀順治二年徵數，並不減少，且復增重，請敕有司核實。

translations.literal: I have read the gracious edict stating that the tax system follows entirely the early Wanli reign, yet observing the collection figures of the second year of Shunzhi, they have not decreased but have again increased; I request that local officials be ordered to verify the facts.
translations.idiomatic: I have read the gracious edict stating that the tax system follows entirely the early Wanli reign, yet the collection figures for the second year of Shunzhi have not decreased but have again increased; I ask that local officials be ordered to verify the facts.

sentences.zh: 州縣六房書吏，初房各二人，今則增至七、八十人，並請敕有司核簡。

translations.literal: In prefectures and counties the six bureaus originally had two clerks each, but now they have increased to seventy or eighty; I also request that local officials be ordered to verify and reduce them.
translations.idiomatic: In prefectures and counties the six bureaus originally had two clerks each, but now they have increased to seventy or eighty; I also ask that local officials be ordered to verify and reduce them.

sentences.zh: 」上命指實，鴻儒復言：「臣籍遷安，明季丁銀，下下二錢，下中四錢，上地一畝七分有奇。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered specific facts; Hongru again said: "Your servant is registered in Qian'an; in the late Ming corvée silver was two qian for lowest-lower grade land, four qian for lower-middle grade, and seven fen odd per mu for upper-grade land."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered specific facts; Hongru replied: "I am registered in Qian'an; in the late Ming corvée silver was two qian for lowest-lower grade land, four qian for lower-middle grade, and seven fen odd per mu for upper-grade land."

translations.literal: The people suffered in making payments and many still fell into arrears.
translations.idiomatic: The people suffered under the burden of payment and many still fell into arrears.

sentences.zh: 一邑如此，他邑可知。
